privacy.s1_body: Our Privacy Policy explains how Etermax collects, uses, stores, shares and treats your Personal Information, and/or any other information belonging to or about users (jointly referred to as "Information".) By Personal Information we understand any and all information used to identify you. By accessing and/or using this website you consent to the collection, transfer, operation, storage, disclosure and other uses of your information as described in this Privacy Policy. If you have any doubts about this Privacy Policy or how this website uses your Personal Information, cookies or similar technologies, please stop using the Services altogether. As set out in the terms and conditions regarding the Services ("Terms of Service"), you must be at least of legal age to access and/or use the Services, or, if it is legally permissible in your state or country, you must have your parents or legal guardian's consent and their agreement to this Privacy Policy to access and/or use the Services. This website has no age restrictions for use; however, you should still consult your local laws to ensure that you are allowed to use the site.
privacy.s2_body: This site in order to provide its Services, receives and deals with user Information as follows: 2.1 Information you provide when you complete the forms when accessing or using the Services or when you create an account with us, you may provide Personal Information which we shall collect. Personal Information can include your email address, username, your photograph, and other personally identifiable information that you choose to provide us with or include in your account. We may also collect Personal Information that you provide when you communicate with the site, or when you communicate with other users of the Services. There is certain Personal Information that shall be public information within our Services, such as, any information you share publicly or your public profile data, content, friends on our Services. Such public information is available to anyone within our Services. 2.2 Information we obtain automatically: we collect information of the user and on how the Services are used, of your interactions with us, as well as information about the electronic device used to access or use the Services (such as, mobile phone or tablets). This information includes: When you interact with us and other users, including messaging and chatting with other users, we collect every comment, communication and chat between you and other users in the Services. Log Data and Gameplay Information: the Services automatically record information created by your use of the Services. This data may include information such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, the referring web page, pages visited, location, your mobile carrier, device and application IDs, search terms, and cookie information. Log data is received when you interact with the Services. This data is used to provide the Services and to measure, customize, and improve them. Etermax also collects and stores your gameplay history, including for some games, your questions and answers history.
privacy.s3_body: You agree that this site, may use the information and categories information they collect for the purposes of managing your account and relationship with the Service and improving your experience when you use it.
privacy.s4_title: 4 DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION TO THIRD PARTIES
privacy.s4_body: This site may share your Personal Information with: Social networks. As it is the case with other services, if you sign up to our Services using a third party, such as Google, your account with us will be connected automatically to your Google account and the username you use on google will become your username and profile picture in this site as well. We may share your username, profile emoji, and information related to your gameplay and use of the Services with said third party, and this information may be published in your timeline. In addition, you may allow the Services to interact with third party social networks and/or platforms, such as google, which may provide data about you to the site. These social networks and/or platforms, or any similar third-party application or website, are owned by third parties and not by Us. You must ensure that you read their terms of service and privacy policies. You understand that when you allow our Services to interact with any third party social network and/or platform, this site may share data about you with your contacts and other users of the Services, and vice versa. This information may include your username, profile emoji, activity status, and information related to your gameplay and use of the Services. Other Service users. When you chat with other users (please check our Terms of Service for the use and potential precautions when using our chats), send communications, or post messages publicly or privately, those communications, comments and chats are shared with the intended recipients, who may then share the communications with others through the Services or outside the Services. You understand that, once you share communications or your profile with others, even if it is only shared with one or two other users, that information is no longer private and cannot be made private again. This site cannot control the actions of other users with whom you communicate or share information. Compliance with Laws and Law Enforcement, and Protection of Our Site, Services and Others. This site may disclose your Personal Information to the extent reasonably necessary to comply with a law, regulation or legal request made by competent agencies. We may access, read, preserve, and disclose your Personal Information, your non-personal information, your user content, chat records or records of other communications, any content you post or upload, and any other information about you, to government or law enforcement officials or private parties, if in our sole discretion, we believe it to be necessary or appropriate. If our project is merged, acquired, or sold, or in the event of a transfer of some or all of our assets, we may disclose or transfer Personal Information and Usage Data in connection with such transaction. You acknowledge that you have no expectation of privacy for or concerning any of the above information, including your chats and communications with other users, content you submit to us (including questions and answers) and content you provide in connection with competitions, information from your profile, or your use of these features of the Site or Services.
privacy.s5_body: The legal basis for the treatment of the personal data described in this Privacy Policy will depend on the personal data implicated and the specific context in which we collect and use it. We can treat Information on the basis of: The need of such treatment for the execution of the contract subscribed with the user (to provide our Services). Our legitimate interest, as long as it does not conflict with your data protection interests or with your basic rights or liberties (statistics implementation, to get a better understanding of our needs and for the improvement of the Services). In some cases, the legal obligation to collect your personal data. In any case, when accessing and/or using this site's Services, you consent to our: Collecting, storing, using, sharing and performing any other action on your Personal Information, according to this Privacy Policy. Using cookies and other similar technologies.
privacy.s6_title: 6 FOR HOW LONG DO WE STORE YOUR INFORMATION?
privacy.s6_body: This site may keep the Information (including Personal Information) for as long as is necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or, even after you have discontinued or deleted any account, or after the end of the provision of the Services, if retention of such Information is reasonably necessary to comply with legal obligations, meet regulatory requirements, resolve disputes between users, prevent fraud, for backup, archival, and/or audit purposes, protect this site's rights or property, or any other use. To determine the period of time the Information is stored, we consider the following: We may store some Information to comply with our legal obligations, as well as to manage our rights (for example to defend our claims in court) or for statistical or historical purposes. Your personal data will be erased from our system and registry when we no longer need to make use of it.
privacy.s7_body: This site takes appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect information against all unauthorized alteration, loss, destruction, treatment, or access, as well as any other form of illegal treatment of Personal Information. However, no data storage or transmission over the Internet or other network can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. Accordingly, this site does not guarantee that the Information will not be accessed, disclosed, altered or destroyed by breach of any of the aforementioned safeguards.
privacy.s8_body: By accepting the present Privacy Policy, by accessing and/or using the Services, you accept the use of cookies and other similar technologies by this site. These technologies are used to provide the Services to the users, making it easier to use our applications, games and our web platform. What are cookies? Cookies and these other technologies are small files or devices that are downloaded into the computer or device, for instance, a mobile device, that you use to access and/or use certain websites or online services. Cookies are used to store and retrieve data on your surfing habits, your device, your connection time, to analyze the operation of the website, etc., in order to provide certain services, offer advertising or implement improvements or new services. What kinds of cookies do we use? Technical cookies: they allow users to surf through a website, platform, or application and use the different options or services therein, such as controlling the exchange and communication of data, identifying the session, accessing restricted access sites, using security elements while navigating. Cookies are used to improve the Sites and apps' usability and functionality, therefore, if you do not wish such data collection as described in this section, you must stop using the Services.
privacy.s9_body: The latest version of the policy will govern the use of the Information and will be at this link. This site may, occasionally and at its discretion, revise and amend this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we decide to change this Privacy Policy, we will inform you by posting the newly revised Privacy Policy on the Site. If you object to any changes to the Privacy Policy, you should immediately stop using the Services and close any related accounts. By continuing to access or use the Services after changes become effective, you agree to be bound by the newly revised Privacy Policy.
